Expand citation macros when roxygen2 writes the Rd files

rdpack_roclet.Rd

A roxygen2 alternative to the rd roclet that writes citations as text rather than \Sexprs, so R CMD build need not install the package.

Usage

rdpack_roclet()

Details

Under the rd roclet, citation macros are written verbatim to .Rd files, and thence expanded to build-stage \Sexprs. R CMD build (or remotes::install_github(), pak::pkg_install()) cannot evaluate such an expression without first installing the package, meaning that a package with compiled code is compiled once to build its tarball, and again when the tarball is installed. rdpack_roclet() writes the same citations without \Sexpr, thus avoiding the double installation.

To use it, name it in place of "rd" in the roclets entry of the Roxygen field in DESCRIPTION:


Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE,
              roclets = c("collate", "namespace", "Rdpack::rdpack_roclet"))

If transitioning to rdpack_roclet(), then after the first run, the field RdMacros: Rdpack may be removed from DESCRIPTION, and Rdpack can move from Imports to Suggests.

Only the citation macros are expanded. The macros \insertFig, \makeFig, \runExamples and \printExample still cause the package to be installed during the build.

Value

an object of class "roclet_rdpack", inheriting from roxygen2's "roclet_rd".

Author

Martin R. Smith

See also

insert_ref and insert_citeOnly for the macros.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
roxygen2::roxygenise(roclets = c("namespace", "Rdpack::rdpack_roclet"))
} # }
